lines.text: I've run the diner on Route 9 for twenty-two years. Every booth in that place has heard it: lights over the ridge, two, three nights a week since spring. And not one soul will put it in writing - because the minute it's in the paper, the town's name means something different. Who buys a house in the UFO town? My sister-in-law listed hers in June. Nobody talks. Everybody watches.
